summary: Empro Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Gan Keat (Eddie) Chin to its Board of Directors effective March 31, 2026, replacing Hui Shan (Karen) Chan who departed March 27, 2026, and the resignation of Siew Lian (Rina) Neoh from the Board effective April 8, 2026, including her committee roles. No disagreements were cited. Mr. Chin serves as CEO of the company's wholly-owned operating subsidiary and previously held COO roles. The Board believes his experience suits him for the role. Additionally, the company changed its fiscal year end from December 31 to June 30. These are routine board changes and a fiscal year adjustment; no special situation is triggered.
